lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance spots are arranged in a regular matrix consisting of approximately 9 vertical columns and 6 horizontal rows between the posterior gill margin and the first dorsal fin origin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of circular blobs to form a grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single continuous horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow-based low-intensity values on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of approximately 12 to 15 high-luminance blobs is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, with higher density located toward the trailing edge and base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A light-colored, elongated appendage (remora) is attached to the ventral region posterior to the left pectoral fin; minor irregularities in pixel intensity are visible on the distal margin of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of smaller, high-frequency luminance spots is visible in the cephalic region, anterior to the first gill slit.
